_about: DEMO TAX CONFIGURATION. Not tax advice and not a filing record. GST treatment is configurable per catalogue category and per SKU; a real shop must confirm every rate and HSN classification with its tax adviser before relying on it. Rates are strings so they are read into Decimal exactly.
priceBasisNote: The demo catalogue's sellingPrice and every supplier cost are treated as GST-exclusive (taxable value). A quotation's existing total is therefore the taxable subtotal, and GST is added on top. No selling price is changed by enabling GST.

Wire.note: Insulated wire and cable. Not listed in any rate-change table of the 56th GST Council press release; carried at the 18% standard rate.

Switch.note: Electrical apparatus for switching circuits. Not listed in any rate-change table of the 56th GST Council press release; carried at the 18% standard rate.

MCB.note: Circuit breakers fall under heading 8536. Not listed in any rate-change table of the 56th GST Council press release; carried at the 18% standard rate.

Ceiling Fan.note: Electric fans. The only 8414 entry in the press release's change tables is hand pumps (8414 20 20); ceiling fans are carried at the 18% standard rate.

LED Lamp.note: NOT CONFIRMED from a primary source. LED lamps were in the 12% slab before 22 September 2025 and that slab was removed; the press release reviewed does not name heading 8539. A secondary source lists 18%. Verify before relying on it.

Accessory.note: NOT CONFIRMED. This demo category spans several HSN headings (conduit, tape, junction boxes, plugs, testers, bells). Each accessory SKU needs its own classification before a real shop relies on this rate.

sources.title: Recommendations of the 56th Meeting of the GST Council (PIB press release, 3 September 2025)
sources.used_for: Rate structure: a Standard Rate of 18% and a Merit Rate of 5%, effective 22 September 2025; the headings above do not appear in its rate-change tables.

sources.title: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate), 17 September 2025 (consolidated HSN-wise schedule, effective 22 September 2025)
sources.used_for: Secondary summary only - not the government text. Lists 8544, 8536, 8539, 9405 and 8414 at 18% (CGST 9%).
